prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished personal portfolio hero banner, exact wide 2:1 composition, 2048 x 1024.
Create a premium editorial physical illustration for an accountant who builds practical software for reconciliations, document intake and engagement management. A thoughtfully arranged tactile workbench: an open gridded ledger with a few abstract column rules, a neat stack of cream document sheets with colored index tabs, a simple graphite desk calculator, a sharpened pencil, a brass clip, and three carefully aligned paper workflow cards. All are physical objects, not a software screenshot. Papers contain only tasteful abstract lines and tiny geometric checkmarks, absolutely no names, financial amounts, organizations, addresses or private data.
Composition: left half has generous clean warm-paper space for a large exceptionally legible editorial heading; right half presents the still-life from an elevated three-quarter camera angle with confident precise shadows. Elegant designed magazine spread with rich material realism and restrained hand-crafted illustration character.
Lighting: soft afternoon studio light, beautiful paper fibers, matte graphite, muted forest-green ledger and tabs, small warm brass details. Palette: warm off-white, dark ink, forest green and ochre.
Text verbatim, prominent: “Tools for real work”.
Small secondary label, exactly: “lEWFkRAD” (lowercase l, uppercase E W F, lowercase k, uppercase R A D).
No other lettering. Avoid: fake product screenshots, app windows, glowing AI icons, circuit brains, stock-photo people, unreadable filler words, glossy plastic, official Hermes/Nous logos, watermarks. This is a practical, mature maker's workbench, beautifully photographed as an editorial miniature.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing portfolio banner only to remove the full stop immediately after the word 'work'. The large heading must read exactly 'Tools for real work' with no final punctuation. Preserve every other aspect: the 2:1 composition, all physical objects, lighting, colors, typography, line breaks, small lEWFkRAD label, and image quality. Do not redraw or rearrange the scene. This is one tiny text punctuation correction.
